businessBrief.description: Family-run plumbing & heating company, 24/7 emergency callouts, boiler repairs, bathroom installations and drain clearing.
businessBrief.targetAudience: Homeowners aged 30-65 in South Birmingham needing urgent or planned plumbing work.
businessBrief.businessGoals: More phone calls for emergency callouts, and more bookings for boiler servicing during winter months.
businessBrief.serviceArea: South Birmingham — Edgbaston, Moseley, Harborne, 8 mile radius from B15.
businessBrief.keyServices: Emergency plumbing, boiler repair & servicing, bathroom installation, drain unblocking.
businessBrief.competitors: Birmingham Plumbing Co, QuickFix Plumbers Birmingham, HomeServe.
businessBrief.existingAssets: Has an existing website (needs SEO work), no Google Business Profile set up yet, not active on social media.
businessBrief.additionalNotes: Client prefers phone calls over web forms — make sure the site has prominent click-to-call buttons. Owner (Dave Mitchell) is hands-off and just wants results reported monthly.

campaignStrategy.summary: Local SEO play focused on emergency + boiler repair intent keywords across South Birmingham. Priority is Google Business Profile setup (currently missing) plus on-page optimisation of service pages, since this is the fastest lever for a local trades business.
campaignStrategy.targetKeywords:
birmingham plumber (880/mo, high competition)
emergency plumber birmingham (320/mo)
boiler repair birmingham (410/mo)
plumber edgbaston (90/mo, low competition)
plumber moseley (70/mo, low competition)
bathroom installation birmingham (260/mo)
blocked drain birmingham (190/mo)
campaignStrategy.nextActions: 1) Verify Search Console access (2nd reminder sent). 2) Set up & optimise Google Business Profile. 3) Run initial technical site audit once GSC access confirmed. 4) Build local landing pages for Edgbaston/Moseley/Harborne.

businessBrief.description: Boutique interior design studio offering full room design, renovation planning, and furniture sourcing for residential clients.
businessBrief.targetAudience: Homeowners and young professionals in London, typically £50k+ household income, looking to redesign 1-3 rooms.
businessBrief.businessGoals: Grow enquiries for the 'full room design' package (£2,500 minimum) and build a pipeline of qualified leads via Google Ads.
businessBrief.serviceArea: Greater London, with a focus on North & Central London postcodes.
businessBrief.keyServices: Full room design, living room design, kitchen design, bedroom design, renovation project management.
businessBrief.competitors: Studio McGee UK, Kelling Designs, local independent designers on Houzz.
businessBrief.existingAssets: Modern portfolio website (needs SEO cleanup), active Instagram (12k followers), no Google Business Profile.
businessBrief.additionalNotes: Client wants Ads to specifically target the 'full room design' package since it has the highest margin. Will review Ads performance after first 90 days before committing further budget.

campaignStrategy.summary: Combined SEO + Ads approach. SEO targets long-tail 'interior designer london' style searches for organic growth. Ads campaign is narrowly targeted at high-intent 'full room design' commercial keywords to protect the £500/mo ad budget and maximise ROAS on the highest-margin package.
campaignStrategy.targetKeywords:
interior designer london (2,400/mo, primary target)
living room design london (410/mo)
kitchen design london (590/mo)
bedroom design ideas london (140/mo)
home renovation designer london (210/mo)
campaignStrategy.adCampaignStructure: Campaign: 'Full Room Design - London' — Ad groups: [Room Design Intent] targeting 'full room design london', 'interior design consultation'; [Renovation Intent] targeting 'home renovation designer'. Budget split 70/30 favouring Room Design Intent group based on early CTR data. 28 commercial-intent keywords total across both groups.
campaignStrategy.nextActions: 1) Second reminder sent for Search Console verification. 2) Once verified, run technical audit (page speed is a known issue — mobile score 44/100). 3) Launch Ads campaign once conversion tracking is confirmed working.

notes.content: Client added to Scramble dashboard. SEO + Ads package activated.
notes.author: cayde

notes.content: Completed full technical site audit. Found 3 critical issues: missing meta descriptions on 12 service pages, slow page speed (mobile score: 44/100), and no structured data markup. Fixes prioritised and added to roadmap.
notes.author: cayde

notes.content: Keyword research complete. 63 target keywords across 5 clusters: interior design london, home renovation, living room design, kitchen design, and bedroom design. Primary target: 'interior designer london' (2,400 searches/mo). Google Ads keyword list also prepared — 28 commercial-intent keywords for paid campaigns.
notes.author: cayde

notes.content: Client is interested in running Google Ads for their 'full room design' service package (£2,500 min). Budget agreed: £500/mo initially. Will review after first 90 days.
